events.summary: Speaker C stated the goal of a profit of 50 million Euros.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: making a profit of fifty million Euros

events.summary: Speaker C suggested making a universal one-for-all style remote.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: the sort of one for all type things

events.summary: Speaker A said the remote should sell for 25 Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: to sell it for twenty five you need a lot of neat features

events.summary: Speaker C converted 25 Euros to about 15 Pounds.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: twenty five Euros, that's about I dunno, fifteen Pounds

events.summary: Speaker C objected that 25 Euros is quite a lot for a remote control.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: And that's quite a lot for a remote control.

events.summary: Speaker D proposed using colour instead of the usual grey or black so the remote stands out.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: maybe we could think about colour? Make that might make it

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a gimmick: a remote that whistles so it can be found when lost.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: something like if you lose it and you can whistle

events.summary: Speaker C accepted the whistle-to-find keyring gimmick.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: The the keyrings, yeah yeah. Okay, that's cool.

events.summary: Speaker B proposed checking market potential, competitors and competitor prices before deciding the cost.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: before deciding the cost of this remote control or any other things

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a good-looking design, since people like to play with the remote.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: They really want to have something good, having a good design

events.summary: Speaker A objected that adding buttons makes the remote big and clunky, while a very small one is easy to lose.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: as you add more buttons to the remote it sometimes gets so big and clunky

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a hand-held, PDA-like form.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: maybe more like a P_D_A_ kind of, just hand held

events.summary: Speaker D withdrew the PDA-style screen idea and said they were not thinking of a PDA screen.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: No, I wasn't, no sorry I wasn't thinking of the screen

events.summary: Speaker C set the target production cost at 12.50 Euros.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: we're trying to make it for twelve Euros fifty

events.summary: Speaker D will look around at other remote controls on the market.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: So you do the looking around at other remote controls.

events.summary: Speaker D will come up with shapes and suggested shades.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: come up with sort of shapes and suggested shades or whatever

events.summary: Speaker B will look into how the remote is made and which materials are available.
